notes:
Summary: mid-market product onboarding platform building in-app copilots (guided flows). Evaluating Hosted API first for fast iteration, then Dedicated for predictable cost and throughput. Primary constraint = consistent latency + strict token cost caps for in-app flows.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "Users must not wait - streaming + tool-calls need sub-300ms per-turn median in our staging traffic" (CTO).
- "We need hard token caps per session to control ARR impact of open-ended onboarding bots" (Head of Product).

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Workload: chat/agent (multi-tool calling), guided onboarding flows, light embeddings for context retrieval.
- Latency SLO: target 200-300ms median for streaming responses; p95 target <600ms for in-app flows.
- Cost constraints: token caps by user journey (e.g., 1500 tokens/session) + visibility into per-route token spend.
- Model preferences: open models favored for cost; want Redwood-verified perf profile vs commercial models.
- Routing: prefer Hosted for early POC, auto-fallback to cheaper variants; plan to evaluate Dedicated for production to meet SLOs and cost predictability.
- Observability: need per-route token/latency dashboards and traces for tool-calls.

Security / compliance notes:
- SOC2 required; DPA in review (legal). EU data residency needed for some customers (must validate Private/Dedicated options). KMS integration required for secrets.

POC plan (high level):
- Phase 1: Hosted API sandbox (3/8 start) - implement streaming + tool-calling prototype, enforce token caps via Redwood routing/presets, collect latency telemetry.
- Phase 2: Stress tests (3/15) - simulate peak onboarding flows, measure median/p95 latencies and cost per session.
- Phase 3: Pricing & Dedicated eval (3/22) - pricing call to discuss reserved capacity options and burst policies.
